newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Caspian initiates Argentine steelmaker Acindar.
newsitem.headline: Caspian initiates Argentine steelmaker Acindar.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Friday it initiated coverage of Argentine steelmaker Acindar with a market performer rating.
"We are initiating coverage on Acindar with a...1997 year-end price target of $3.00, implying a return of 10 percent," analyst Ricardo Cavanagh wrote in a report.
Acindar, Argentina's leading long-steel producer, is expected to attain a three-year compound annual growth rate in earnings of 24 percent, Cavanagh said.
It trades at an estimated FY98 P/E of 16.2x, a premium to also local Siderar (13.5x), Siderca (12.5x), the domestic market (14.2x) and the regional steel average (12.7x), he added.
